svg.title: The internet is wet
svg.desc: A dark world map, dotted where there is land, draws fifteen real submarine cables across the oceans. Packets of light stream along them, and three journeys ride a cable each: a video call from New York to Bude, a photo from Singapore to Marseille and a game move from Tokyo to Oregon that leaves the right edge of the map and comes back on the left.

g.text: 15 of the 500-odd cables on the sea floor, 109,000 km of glass.
